module: Masked screen blur. Creates the object "ScreenBlurFX" (type PostEffectMaskedBlur, enabled, rendered after OverlayRender, target at 40% of the screen) with three sub-effects: Y blur, X blur (shader DOF_Gausian.cs.hlsl) then SimpleBlendShader which mixes the sharp screen and the blurred image according to the #screenBlurMask mask. Used for example to blur the background under menus. No exported function.
